content: Is Keuluwanen wey Ked-etiman te Megbevayà

content.text: Nengazen, midsusi a kenikew umbe nekilala a kenikew.
Netuenan nu ke keenu a ebpinuu wey edhitindeg.
Minsan diyè ka te meziyù netuenan nu is nengetaǥù te isip ku.
Egkaahà a kenikew ke edterebahu a wey ke edhimeley a.
Netuenan nu is langun he ebeelan ku.
Nengazen, minsan kenè e pa ebpekekaǥi, ne netuenan nu en he zaan ke hengkey is egkeǥiyen ku.
Diyè ka te peliǥuy ku,
ne egkelesaǥan a kenikew pinaaǥi te ǥehem nu.
Is kegketueni nu mehitenged kediey ne utew egkein-inuwi;
kenè ku heini egkesavut.
Hendei e man ebayà para melikayi ku is Mulin-ulin nu?
Egkehimu ve he ed-elesan ku sikew?
Emun edhendiyà a te langit, ne ziyè ka;
emun edhendiyà a te iveyaan, ne ziyè ka zaan.
Emun be e zà ebpekelayang ne edlayang a pehendiyà te edsilaan etawa ziyà a ed-ubpà te utew meziyù he ziyà te edsenlepan,
ne zutun ka is ed-aǥak wey edtavang kedì.
Minsan mebpetambun e pa te merusirem
wey minsan meveeli pa he mezukilem heini is kerayag he nekeliǥuy kediey kenà a ebpekeeles.
Su minsan is merusirem ne kenà merusirem diyà te kenikew,
ne is mezukilem iring ded kerayag te maandew.
Nekilala a kenikew su iyan ka mibaal te tivuuk he lawa ku.
Iyan ka mibpurma kediey ziyà te ǥetek te iney ku.
Edeliǥen ku sikew su egkein-inuwan is kebeeli nu kediey.
Egkein-inuwan is menge vaal nu, ne netuenan ku heeyan.
Neehè nu is menge tulan ku hein mibpurma a kenikew ziyà te seled te ǥetek te iney ku.
Naahà ad kenikew minsan hein wazè e pa mepurma.
Is kahabet te menge andew te kegkeuyag-uyag ku ne nekesurat en diyà te libru nu, minsan wazè pa mebpuun is untung ku.
He Megbevayà, kenè ku egketegkad is menge ed-isipen nu;
utew heini mahabet.
Emun ebilangen ku heini ne edhuna pa he mahabet te menge pantad.
Te kegkepukew ku, is isip ku ziyà gihapun te kenikew.
He Megbevayà, berakat he ebpenhimetayan nu is menge lalung!
Berakat he mebpekeziyù kayi te kediey is menge ebpenhimatey te menge etew.
Mezaat is menge lalag dan mehitenged kenikew.
Heini is menge kuntada nu, undaunda is kedsempita zan te ngazan nu.
Nengazen, egkeepesan ku is egkeepes kenikew.
Egkeepesan ku is ebpekigkuntada kenikew.
Utew ku egkeepesi sikandan;
mid-isip ku sikandan he menge kuntada ku.
Susiya a kenikew, Megbevayè ku, su para metueni nu is kayi te ǥehinawa ku.
Gezami a, su para metueni nu is ed-isipen ku.
Ahaa nu ke zuen mezaat he vaal ku,
ne eǥaka a ziyà te zalan he ereg he ed-ikulen ku taman te taman.
